messages.author: 9c1a93cd557f488e
messages.subject: histogram not working
parts:
I have a numeric variable called FCPU.
When I use it to create a Histogram, it works.
When I took the sqrt or log of FCPU and try to create a Histogram i get an error message, even though R says that the newly created variable SQFCPU is numeric.

R Code:
SQFCPU<-sqrt(Broiler$FCPU)
hist(Broiler$SQFCPU, col="purple", xlab="FCPU", main="Broiler data")

Error message: "Error in hist.default(Broiler$SQFCPU, col = "purple", xlab = "FCPU", main = "Broiler data") : 
  'x' must be numeric"

tnx

messages.author: b35e99045f6c74c2
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: histogram not working
parts:
Hi Laura,

In your code you assign the square root to variable SQFCPU and then use Broiler$SQFCPU for the plot (these are different objects within R). Still,
hist(Broiler$SQFCPU, col="purple", xlab="FCPU", main="Broiler data")

should work if Broiler$SQFCPU is numeric. Could you what typeof(Broiler$SQFCPU) and class(Broiler$SQFCPU) return? 

Vince

messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: histogram not working
parts:
Hi Laura,

But note:

SQFCPU<-sqrt(Broiler$FCPU)
hist(Broiler$SQFCPU, col="purple", xlab="FCPU", main="Broiler data")

You're using Broiler$SQFCPU not SQFCPU (I mentioned this in the first email). You need

hist(SQFCPU, col="purple", xlab="FCPU", main="Broiler data")

since this isn't a column of the dataframe Broiler (unless you assign it to be one).

V
